components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The brass-plate CTA. Save, Create Character, the affirmative commit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #D4A95C; color: #0B0E2C; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 24px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(244,228,184,0.4), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(107,78,26,0.6); transition: background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F4E4B8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #A67C28; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4A95C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mystic Button
components.description: The ritual CTA. Push the Roll, prayer-eligible confirms. The only teal control.
components.css: .ds-btn-mystic { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #2BA3A0; color: #0B0E2C; border: 1px solid #2BA3A0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 24px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-mystic:hover { background: #3FAEAA; border-color: #3FAEAA; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(43,163,160,0.35); } .ds-btn-mystic:active { background: #1F827F; } .ds-btn-mystic:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4A95C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined brass. Cancel, Skip, Reroll. Sits between filled primary and borderless ghost.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #D4A95C; border: 1px solid #D4A95C; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 24px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), border-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(212,169,92,0.1); border-color: #F4E4B8; color: #F4E4B8; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgba(212,169,92,0.18); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4A95C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Night-surface field with a brass-shadow resting border that warms to brass on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; box-sizing: border-box; background: #15193F; border: 1px solid #6B4E1A; border-radius: 4px; color: #F4E4B8; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; padding: 8px 16px; transition: border-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #D9CDB0; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #A67C28; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4A95C; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #D4A95C; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill toggle, outline at rest, solid fill when pressed. The one place a pill radius is allowed.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: transparent; color: #F4E4B8; border: 1px solid #D4A95C; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 3px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(212,169,92,0.12); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #D4A95C; color: #0B0E2C; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4A95C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Featured Card
components.description: Beveled brass plate for the active session or a selected Icon. Flat-on-dark, depth from the inset bevel.

The Traveler
Patron of explorers and pilots.

narrative.overview: The Coriolis universe is deep-space science fiction wrapped in pre-modern, sacred, ornate language. Starships wear arabesques on their hulls; pilots whisper to the Icons before they push dice. The companion app is a ceremonial instrument, brass etched on the indigo void, closer to an astrolabe than to a SaaS console. The system is dark-first; light (parchment) is reserved for the share-link viewer and the high-contrast accessibility variant. Ornament is welcome where it carries meaning and goes silent where information density rules. It explicitly rejects the generic dark-mode tool, Notion-grey minimalism, the virtual-tabletop density of Foundry and Roll20, and Western-fantasy parchment-and-dragons.
keyCharacteristics: Brass (#D4A95C) on indigo void (#0B0E2C) is the entire brand; greys are forbidden.
Ceremonial, restrained motion that eases out, never bounces.
Display type (Forum) names things; it never labels them.
Flat on dark. Depth comes from brass borders and inset bevels, not drop shadows.
Color is never the sole signal; meaning is doubled with icon, prefix, or aria state.

rules.name: The Brass-on-Indigo Rule
rules.body: The palette is the brand. No drift toward neutral grey, zinc, slate, or generic dark-mode black. If a surface looks grey, it is wrong; tint it back toward indigo.

rules.name: The One Teal Voice Rule
rules.body: Mystic teal is the single accent permitted to break the brass monopoly, and only to signal the mystical or the Push.

rules.name: The Ornament-with-Purpose Rule
rules.body: Decoration appears where it reinforces meaning and is forbidden where it competes with information density.

rules.name: The Reserved Display Rule
rules.body: Forum names things; it never labels them. Forbidden on buttons, tooltips, and table cells.

rules.name: The Single Weight Rule
rules.body: Forum ships one weight (Regular 400). Emphasis comes from size and tracking, never from a faked bold.

rules.name: The Flat-on-Dark Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on dark surfaces. Convey depth with a brass border plus an inset highlight.

rules.name: The Glow-as-Meaning Rule
rules.body: A glow is never ambient polish. Teal glow means mystic, crimson glow means danger. If a glow does not encode state, delete it.

dos: Do keep brass on indigo as the entire brand voice. Tint every neutral toward Coriolis-blue.
Do reserve mystic teal for the mystical and the Push, and crimson for HP loss and destruction.
Do convey depth with brass borders and inset bevels; keep dark surfaces flat.
Do double every color signal. The active combat turn carries a brass left treatment plus a prefix and aria-current, not color alone.
Do round buttons to 4px and keep them square-shouldered.
Do use Forum to name things and Inter to label them.
Do let motion stay restrained and ceremonial, easing out, respecting prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't build a generic dark mode. The indigo is Coriolis-blue, not zinc, slate, or neutral grey.
Don't make it a Notion clone: no floating menus, no slash commands, no minimal-grey aesthetic.
Don't make it a Foundry / Roll20 GM screen: this is a digital character sheet that happens to have a combat tracker, not a virtual tabletop.
Don't go skeuomorphic. The aesthetic is digital made ceremonial, not digital faking paper or leather.
Don't use Western-fantasy iconography: no parchment-with-blood-spatter, no dragons, no medieval longswords.
Don't ship pill-shaped buttons; pills are reserved for status chips.
Don't put a drop shadow on a dark surface, or any box-shadow outside the defined tokens.
Don't use Forum for buttons, tooltips, or table cells.
Don't write a private brand hex into a .vue or .scss file; reference the token.
Don't use a gradient on text, a side-stripe colored border, or decorative glassmorphism.
